sar.narrative: Customer C07987 with card C07987-K2 had suspicious activity on 2016-12-01 involving transaction 3503878. The transaction was a $99.92 online card-not-present purchase conducted on a device marked new for this account. The activity occurred through the online channel, and no physical merchant location was identified in the provided facts. The real-time model scored the transaction at 0.90 fraud probability under the pattern card_not_present_new_device. An evidence request returned a simulated denial stating the customer did not make the $99.92 purchase and still has the card. The same three-card device profile also included connected cards C06224-K2 and C11309-K1. Those two other cards transacted within 48 hours at near-identical amounts of $100.06 and $100.00. The flagged amount was normal relative to the card’s prior behavior, and ProductCD R had prior established use on this card. However, the use of a new device for an online transaction, the customer denial, and the near-identical activity across three cards on the same device profile make the activity suspicious. Total exposure for this episode is $99.92.
